questions.text: What situation or person makes you feel the most anger right now?
questions.verse_text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.

questions.text: Do you feel like your anger is justified? Tell me more about that.
questions.verse_text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath.

questions.text: Underneath the anger, what other emotions might be hiding?
questions.verse_text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

questions.text: Has your anger ever hurt someone you love? How did that feel afterward?
questions.verse_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

questions.text: Is there something you're angry at God about?
questions.verse_text: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me? How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily?

questions.text: What would peace look like in the situation that's making you angry?
questions.verse_text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
follow_up_hints: As much as lies in you
Some things aren't in our control

questions.text: Is there a boundary you need to set that would help reduce this anger?
questions.verse_text: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

questions.text: Have you ever felt righteous anger - anger at injustice? How is that different?
questions.verse_text: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand.

questions.text: What would it take for you to release this anger to God?
questions.verse_text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

questions.text: If you could speak to the person you're angry at without consequences, what would you say?
questions.verse_text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
